import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static BufferedReader br;
    static StringTokenizer st;
    static PrintWriter pw;

    static String nextToken() throws IOException {
        while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        }
        return st.nextToken();
    }

    static int nextInt() throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
    }

    static long nextLong() throws IOException {
        return Long.parseLong(nextToken());
    }

    static double nextDouble() throws IOException {
        return Double.parseDouble(nextToken());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        solve();
        pw.close();
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        int R = nextInt();
        int C = nextInt();
        int T = (2 * R + 2 * C);
        char[] c = new char[T];
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            c[i] = nextToken().charAt(0);
        }

        long[] lscore = new long[T];
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            lscore[i] = 0;
        }
        lscore[2 * R - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * R; i < T; i++) {
            lscore[i] = lscore[i - 1] * i / (i - 2 * R + 1);
        }

        long[] r1score = new long[T + 1];
        long[] rscore = new long[T + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            r1score[i] = choose(i, R - 1);
            rscore[i] = choose(i, R);
        }

        long mval = 0;
        int acnt = 0, bcnt = 0;
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            boolean u = mval > 0;
            if (bcnt == T / 2)
                u = true;
            if (acnt == T / 2)
                u = false;

            if (u) {
                acnt++;
                mval -= r1score[T / 2 - acnt] * rscore[T / 2 - bcnt];
            } else {
                bcnt++;
                mval += r1score[T / 2 - bcnt] * rscore[T / 2 - acnt];
            }
        }
        mval = Math.max(mval, -mval);

        long tsum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            tsum += lscore[i];
        }

        tsum = rscore[T / 2] * rscore[T / 2];

        Map<Pair, Long> mmap = new HashMap<>();
        mmap.put(new Pair(0, 0), 1L);
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 2 * R - 1; i--) {
            Map<Pair, Long> nmap = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
                Pair pair = entry.getKey();
                long sum = pair.x;
                int acnt = pair.y;
                long ncount = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T / 2 - acnt;
                int bleft = i + 1 - aleft;

                long asum = sum + r1score[aleft - 1] * rscore[bleft];
                long bsum = sum - r1score[bleft - 1] * rscore[aleft];

                if (c[i] == 'A') {
                    nmap.put(new Pair(asum, acnt + 1), nmap.getOrDefault(new Pair(asum, acnt + 1), 0L) + ncount);
                    nmap.put(new Pair(bsum, acnt), nmap.getOrDefault(new Pair(bsum, acnt), 0L) + 0);
                } else if (c[i] == 'B') {
                    nmap.put(new Pair(asum, acnt + 1), nmap.getOrDefault(new Pair(asum, acnt + 1), 0L) + 0);
                    nmap.put(new Pair(bsum, acnt), nmap.getOrDefault(new Pair(bsum, acnt), 0L) + ncount);
                } else {
                    nmap.put(new Pair(asum, acnt + 1), nmap.getOrDefault(new Pair(asum, acnt + 1), 0L) + ncount);
                    nmap.put(new Pair(bsum, acnt), nmap.getOrDefault(new Pair(bsum, acnt), 0L) + ncount);
                }
            }
            tsum -= lscore[i];

            mmap.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : nmap.entrySet()) {
                Pair pair = entry.getKey();
                long sum = pair.x;
                int acnt = pair.y;
                long ncount = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T / 2 - acnt;
                int bleft = i - aleft;
                if (acnt > (T / 2) || (T - i - acnt) > (T / 2))
                    continue;
                long lsum = rscore[aleft] * rscore[bleft];
                if (sum < (-mval - lsum) || sum > (mval + lsum))
                    continue;
                mmap.put(new Pair(sum, acnt), mmap.getOrDefault(new Pair(sum, acnt), 0L) + ncount);
            }
        }

        long bscore = (long) 1e18;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
            Pair pair = entry.getKey();
            long sum = pair.x;
            bscore = Math.min(bscore, Math.max(sum, -sum));
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
            Pair pair = entry.getKey();
            long sum = pair.x;
            int acnt = pair.y;
            long ncount = entry.getValue();

            if (sum == bscore || sum == -bscore) {
                int nleft = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 2 * R - 1; i++) {
                    if (c[i] == 'A')
                        acnt++;
                    if (c[i] == '?')
                        nleft++;
                }

                ncount *= choose(nleft, T / 2 - acnt);
                ans += ncount;
            }
        }

        pw.println(ans);
    }

    static long choose(int x, int y) {
        if (y > x || y < 0) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            res = res * (x - i);
            res = res / (i + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static class Pair {
        long x;
        int y;

        public Pair(long x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return y == pair.y && x == pair.x;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return (int) (x ^ (x >>> 32)) * 31 + y;
        }
    }
